name: Jilltania Fizz Melkiana
original_name: ジルタニア・フィズ・メルキアーナ
source: Present emperor governing the Empire of Melkia, and half-brother of Weissheit. In order to bring further prosperity to his country Giltania expands his territory. He takes it as essential to promote development and research - he believes the ultimate magic weapon is absolute power. Governs in a radical way, he will even use prohibited art and magic that lead to major incidents in the middle of research.
translation: Present emperor governing the Empire of Melkia, and half-brother of Weissheit. In order to bring further prosperity to his country Giltania expands his territory. He takes it as essential to promote development and research - he believes the ultimate magic weapon is absolute power. Governs in a radical way, he will even use prohibited art and magic that lead to major incidents in the middle of research.
